source: Europe PMC REST (search + /references). No invented citations.
notes: Direct edges exist only when a reference list retrieved from Europe PMC names another corpus paper (PMID / DOI / normalized title match).
Co-citation edges exist only when two corpus papers appear together in a third corpus paper's retrieved reference list.
Bibliographic coupling is recorded when two corpus papers share at least two in-corpus references.
Keyword co-occurrence is a declared fallback used only if the citation-derived graph is sparse (<120 edges).
Displayed edges are capped at the top ~700 by combined weight and endpoint degree to keep gold traces faint behind the stars.
